purpose: Exact official Supabase PostgreSQL 17.6 platform baseline pins for KIV-218 Class B topology. These artifacts present platform objects the Kivo lineage does not create. They are not a third Kivo bootstrap.

pgmq.why: The official darwin-arm64 CLI tarball omits pgmq.control. Exact method-1 file 0103_brain_execution_substrate.sql requires CREATE EXTENSION pgmq. The same supabase/postgres pin's nix/ext/pgmq installs SQL-only pgmq 1.5.1 from tembo-io/pgmq. Vendored files are that official install output, not invented queue DDL.

darwin_adhoc_libiconv.why: Official tarball libiconv.dylib has an invalid code signature on macOS 26 (AMFI SIGKILL / Code Signature Invalid). Host re-sign with codesign --force --sign - is a codesign repair of the official dylib, not SQL invention.

method_1_psql_flags.0059: no transaction wrap; CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY

class_b_query_role_note: Official migrate.sh demotes postgres. Class B tooling uses that demoted login role so PF-4-SET-ROLE is the expected 42501 denial. supabase_admin remains bootstrap-only for method 1 apply.
